intro.title: NovaGrid: Integrated Solar & Storage Solution
intro.description: NovaGrid combines solar generation with intelligent battery storage to maximize your renewable energy investment. Achieve 80-90% solar self-consumption by storing excess daytime generation for evening use. Stop exporting valuable solar energy to the grid at low rates — store it and use it when electricity prices peak. Complete energy independence with zero fossil fuel dependency and 24/7 clean power availability.
